assumptions.statement: The provisioning process relies on a user_data script to perform customisation during instance initialisation.
assumptions.quote: Our provisioning process with Terraform uses a user_data script to customise the installation during the instance initialisation.

assumptions.statement: There is a significant amount of common customisation logic (e.g., puppet client, updates, disks) that is currently duplicated across projects.
assumptions.quote: Parts of this customisation will be common to most projects, for instance, install the puppet client, apply package updates, add external disks, etc.

assumptions.statement: The current node_group module architecture supports appending an additional script to a default user_data script.
assumptions.quote: the node_group module takes a parameter for a default user_data script, and optionally accepts another parameter for an additional script that is appended to the default one.
